name: Duguay-Trouin
shortDescription: Tanky, big-gunned French light cruiser with the tier's longest range and hardest-hitting torpedoes, undone by the thinnest armor and worst detection in her class.

stats.label: AA
stats.value: 15 DPS stock, 28 DPS upgraded, across two mounts

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 60s cooldown, unlimited charges. Standard reset, nothing that sets her apart from other tech-tree cruisers this tier.

consumables.name: Catapult Fighter
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 100s uptime on an 80s cooldown. Same stock numbers most tier III cruisers carry, and her only answer to spotter planes and air strikes.

turrets.label: B
turrets.note: Superfires over A, same 3-way coverage. Community feedback singles out this AB-XY layout as excellent for the tier.

torpedoMounts.label: Port 1
torpedoMounts.note: Fixed to this broadside, no centerline swing. Forward pair, mirrored by Starboard 1.

strengths: 26,700 hp upgraded is the most hit points of any tier III cruiser, ahead of Kuma's 24,200, Phoenix and Giussano's 24,000, Danae's 23,000, and Karlsruhe's 22,700
13.1 km upgraded main battery range beats every other tier III cruiser researched so far
155mm guns are the biggest caliber at the tier, edging out Karlsruhe's 150mm and the 152mm crowd (Phoenix, Danae, Giussano)
12,233 torpedo damage is the hardest-hitting torpedo of any tier III cruiser, ahead of Danae's 11,967 upgraded and Phoenix's 11,733
12 torpedo tubes total, tied with Danae for the most at tier III
AB-XY turret layout keeps all eight guns firing bow-in or stern-out, called out specifically in player feedback as excellent for the tier
weaknesses: 10-30mm armor is the thinnest of any tier III cruiser, thinner even than Giussano's 6-40mm
10.9 km sea detection and 6.5 km air detection are both the worst of any tier III cruiser
10.9s stock rudder shift is the slowest of any tier III cruiser, though it drops to a respectable 7.8s upgraded
12.0s main battery reload trails every tier III cruiser but Giussano's 15.0s
Torpedo tubes are fixed one per broadside with no centerline swing, so a torpedo run commits to a side before you fire
Only 1 upgrade slot to work with
tips: Use the 13.1 km upgraded range to poke from distance instead of closing, the armor and detection both punish getting seen up close
Don't sit still in return fire. That 10-30mm plating turns a well-aimed AP salvo into a citadel fast
Pick your broadside early on a torpedo run, the tubes can't swing to the other side once you've committed
Bow-in or stern-out, both postures keep all eight guns live thanks to the AB-XY layout, so there's rarely a reason to show full broadside
Assume you're spotted before you spot them. Worst detection at the tier means islands and range are your friends, not brawling

threats.reason: 10-30mm armor is the thinnest of any tier III cruiser, a close brawl goes badly fast.

threats.threat: Stealthier or faster cruisers and destroyers
threats.reason: Worst detection at the tier means most peers see her before she sees them.

summary: Tankiest cruiser at tier III by hit points, with the longest gun range and the hardest-hitting torpedoes in her class.
Worst detection and slowest stock rudder shift of any tier III cruiser leave her exposed if caught out of position.
Thin 10-30mm plating turns any well-aimed AP hit into a serious citadel risk.
Twelve fixed-broadside tubes deliver the tier's hardest-hitting torpedo salvo once she commits to a side.
playstyle.detail: Duguay-Trouin was the first large French warship built after the last war, and Legends leans into that transitional design: real hit points and reach, but nothing like the armor to back it up. The AB-XY turret layout keeps all eight 155mm guns in the fight whether she's bow-in or stern-out, and her upgraded range lets her poke from further out than any other tier III cruiser. The problem is getting away with it. Detection is the worst in her class, the rudder is sluggish until upgraded, and 10-30mm of plating means a spotted broadside ends badly. She rewards a cruiser player who picks a line, pokes from range, and never forgets the twelve torpedoes waiting for anyone who overextends.

goalTags.note: 12,233 damage is the hardest-hitting torpedo of any tier III cruiser, delivered across 12 tubes.
